rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the reported 3AB and appropriately cautious about static-image limits, but it overstates confidence in expansion and visible blastocoel/TE organization given the image is somewhat indistinct and partially collapsed-looking.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior cycle history, semen quality, BMI, endometrium, and day-5 status into prognosis and transfer planning.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo and patient factors; only minor overinterpretation of morphology and outcome ranges.
Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and caution about add-ons; minor speculative elements remain.
Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including hydrosalpinx review, cavity assessment, luteal support, and future workup if failure recurs.
